page.title: Shell and the Unix philosophy
page.desc: Small programs that do one thing well, composed with pipes over text streams. Doug McIlroy's pipes (1973) and philosophy are why the command line is still the universal glue.
page.intro: Small programs that do one thing well, composed with pipes over text streams. Doug McIlroy's pipes (1973) and philosophy are why the command line is still the universal glue.

synapses.lead: Write programs that do one thing well
synapses.text: McIlroy's summary: do one thing, work together, handle text streams because that is a universal interface.
grep | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn is a data pipeline in one line; the shell is a lazy, streaming functional language in disguise.
